{"report":"Repaired src/session.js: tracks whether a query and an individual attempt have actually entered execution. When the last observer leaves a fresh, never-started pending offline attempt, it is settled back to idle, preventing queued/reconnect continuation from invoking queryFn. Shared signal-consumption state remains query-owned and is still reset only at actual execution; attempt controllers remain attempt-owned.\n\nVerified with /runtime/node v16.20.2 using focused regression checks: fresh offline unsubscribe/reconnect, queued-resume race, shared observers, cached and initial-data paused refreshes, unconsumed background completion, and consumed-signal cancellation. All passed. No project test suite/build scripts were present, so no broader suite was run."}
